title: Starting an already-running bot fails locally, without a second poll
why: Two overlapping polls on one bot used to split the updates in silence — each path got half, with no error anywhere. The server now answers 409, but an SDK that starts a second loop is causing that eviction rather than reporting it, and the two would fight. The failure must be local and immediate: no request, no second loop, an error the caller gets before anything reaches the network.
